pro_description.value: (Action, 15ft radius sphere) You choose a point you can see. Any creatures or objects within a 15ft radius of that point are all pulled towards its centre. Any creatures or objects pulled in this way take xd10 force damage, where x is equal to your proficiency bonus. Just before using this ability you are not considered blind.

con_description.value: After you use this ability you must make a Constitution Saving throw. The DC for this save is 10. If you fail this saving throw your Constitution score is reduced by 1. If your Constitution score is reduced to 0 in this way, you die. Your Constitution score returns to normal after you take a long rest.
